source_context: A newer operative original amendment supersedes 2020 Pickled Eggs clause from 1 May 2025; current published FPSFA 2025 chapter changes identity evidence needed for coconut milk, chia, water chestnut and casings. Identity guidance is not CTR numeric approval.
method: Official current chapter compendium clauses and FSSAI-indexed originals. The primary original 2024 FPSFA 21 October amendment operative text is independently indexed; older 2020 originals remain not fully rendered in this runtime.

cases.topic: Pickled eggs — 2020 identity standard explicitly superseded
cases.current_section: FPSFA 2.5.3(5), replacement of Clause 5 in First Amendment 2024
cases.current_substance: The 21 October 2024 original Gazette replaces the Pickled Eggs clause, creating separately described vinegar-based and oil-based process types with packaging/name conditions. This amendment took effect 1 May 2025.
cases.unsafe_prior_inference: The 2020 pickled-egg recipe pH 3.2–3.6 and formulation requirements must not be presented as the only current specification after replacement. Inspect the current text for the actual selected subtype.
cases.missing: Actual egg type, vinegar-based or oil-based manufacturing procedure, pack label/identity, as-sold egg/brine recipe and individual pesticide original MRL scope.

cases.topic: Coconut milk powder — sodium caseinate possible despite non-dairy label
cases.current_substance: The current official chapter identifies dehydrated/spray-dried coconut milk from Cocos nucifera and expressly permits addition of maltodextrin and sodium caseinate. This is a product-identity clause, not a dairy milk CTR lead comparator.
cases.unsafe_prior_inference: Do not conclude a particular product is milk-protein-free, free of milk-derived ingredients or subject to the dairy milk lead comparator solely because the product standard has a non-dairy title.
cases.missing: Actual approved manufacturer BOM, sodium-caseinate statement, full allergen risk/label assessment and exact independent lead CTR food article.

cases.current_substance: Official current cereal-products chapter defines chia seeds as Salvia hispanica L. of family Labiatae.
cases.unsafe_prior_inference: Recognized seed species does not by itself classify the food as a named lead-contaminant cereal, oilseed, pulse or nut for CTR.
cases.missing: Supplier botanical identity, raw/processed/hulled form, correct named CTR lead commodity article and signed case application.

cases.topic: Water chestnut flour — Trapa species ground dried nuts
cases.current_substance: Official current fruit-and-vegetable chapter defines Singhare ka atta as flour made by grinding clean, sound, dried Trapa bispinosa or Trapa quadrispinosa nuts.
cases.unsafe_prior_inference: Do not map to cereal flour, fresh chestnut, canned water chestnut or a generic nut contaminant maximum just because the article is called flour.
cases.missing: Authenticated Trapa species/supplier manufacturing specification, actual flour identity and directly applicable CTR metal row.

cases.topic: Animal casings — natural animal organ source, not artificial analogue
cases.current_substance: The 2020 Gazette identifies casings derived from intestines, oesophagus or urinary bladder of slaughtered food animals, with dried or wet-salted forms and controls for cleanliness.
cases.unsafe_prior_inference: Artificial or synthetic casing cannot be assumed to satisfy the defined animal-casing product identity; likewise its food contaminant lead article is not necessarily meat/offal/gelatin.
cases.missing: Actual casing organ/species and natural/artificial origin, finished treatment and original applicable lead clause.

cases.topic: Egg powder — processed and dried food, not undried egg by default
cases.current_section: FPSFA 2.5.3 Egg Powder; CTR 2.3.1 named pesticide-food pairs
cases.current_substance: The 2020 Gazette names egg powder as a separately standardized product, alongside frozen egg, liquid egg and pickled eggs. Distinct processing form matters to interpreting an eggs-based pesticide residue reference.
cases.unsafe_prior_inference: An MRL provided for eggs, for a named pesticide and specified basis, is not automatically the same result expression in dehydrated egg powder.
cases.missing: Actual supplier egg species, whole/albumen/yolk identity, moisture and drying/concentration basis, named pesticide and legal source MRL interpretation.
